text:
sophia-mktg: Quick note from the weekly KPI pass 1        Launch posts + webinar promos showing big engagement lift but the "new MQLs" tile is flat. Can analytics/ops take a look? :magnifying_glass_tilted_left:
leo-analytics: I'm seeing the same. Clicks -> regs healthy; MQLs not trending. Initial suspicion: attribution window and a parser normalization that happened last week. Pulling joins now.
mia-ops: FYI we merged a mapping that normalizes campaign aliases (launchnet -> launch_net) last Tuesday. That could cause dashboards that filter exact campaign names to miss rows. I'll check routing logs.
caleb-growth: If possible, we should also check the webinar -> MQL lag. Historically that's ~5-7 days; a recent spike in registrations could take time to flow into MQL counts.
leo-analytics: quick debug query I'm running: ```sql
SELECT campaign_label, count(*) as regs, sum(is_mql::int) as mqls
FROM processed.leads
WHERE event_date >= '2026-03-10' AND campaign_family = 'spring_launch'
GROUP BY 1;
```
pipeline-bot: Pipeline change: campaign-normalizer v2.0 deployed 2026-03-19T01:03Z (note: alias folding). Backfill recommended for dashboards.
mia-ops: Found mapping lines in logs: `2026-03-19T01:03Z map: campaign_alias=launch_net_v2 -> launch_net` and a fallback that sets empty campaign -> 'unknown'. That fallback may be the culprit for rows classified out of the dashboard.
leo-analytics: Running a backfill estimate. If we remap legacy aliases to normalized labels in analytics views, we should see MQLs move up. Will produce a before/after delta for the KPI deck.
sophia-mktg: For the slide copy: "Engagement from launch posts and webinar promos is above benchmark; apparent MQL gap caused by campaign-label normalization and short attribution window. Ops/Analytics are backfilling; numbers to be revised." Keep it short and clear.
caleb-growth: Also recommend we surface two micro-cards: (1) "percent leads with campaign tag" and (2) "attribution window delta (7d vs 14d)" so PMs spot instrumentation vs real-performance issues.
mia-ops: I'll add a mapping shim to preserve legacy labels for the dashboards and kick the backfill for the last 14 days. Adding an alert if campaign-null > 1%. ETA ~90 minutes.
leo-analytics: I'll re-run the funnel after backfill and update slide 2 in the KPI deck (link: https://dash.redwood.ai/reports/spring-launch-kpi).
sophia-mktg: Thank you. Let's reconvene Friday AM to confirm numbers. If backfill fixes it, we'll keep the benchmark narrative positive; if not, we'll dig deeper into the routing heuristics. :coffee:
